tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List assets TorrentSwap can swap, with the id to use in get_quote, ticker, network and decimals. Any two different assets can be swapped. Optional query/network filters.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List the cross-chain protocols TorrentSwap routes through (NEAR Intents, Chainflip, Flashnet, THORChain, Pact Swap and more), with how each executes and how it holds funds. Use the ids to filter get_quote.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get live quotes for swapping one asset to another (cross-chain or same-chain). Returns routes ranked by amount received, each with a quoteToken, the executing protocol, expectedReceive, minimumReceived and estimated time. All fees (network, protocol and platform) are included.

tools.name: validate_address
tools.description: Check that an address is valid for the network of an asset before creating a swap (checksums included). Returns the canonical form.

tools.name: create_swap
tools.description: Create a swap from a quoteToken returned by get_quote. Returns a one-time depositAddress, the exact amount to send, expiresAt and a swapId for tracking. tools.name: get_swap_status
tools.description: Check the progress of a swap by swapId: awaiting_deposit, confirming, exchanging, sending, completed, refunded, failed or expired.
